    (f : WeightTwoNewform N)
    (hf_int : HasIntegralQExpansion f.toCuspForm) :
    ∃ E : WeierstrassCurve ℚ,
      E.IsElliptic ∧
      HasConductor E N ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
        ((E.LFunction n : ℤ) : ℂ) =
          (PowerSeries.coeff n)
            (UpperHalfPlane.qExpansion 1
              ⇑f.toCuspForm) := by
  sorry
